building: Alpha Gamma Delta (Beta Xi), Purdue University

corroborating_source.provider: Alpha Gamma Delta Fraternity Housing Corporation
corroborating_source.evidence: Lists Beta Xi at Purdue University, 1010 David Ross Road, as a house. The page also lists 1965, 23,288 square feet, and 74 capacity.

sources.provider: Purdue GIS, BuildingShapesZip4 ArcGIS FeatureServer, layer 0
sources.snapshot_reconciliation: The 2026-10-28 live FID 757 query in EPSG:4326 matches the 2026-10-27 snapshot exactly for all attributes and polygon coordinates. The live layer metadata declares its native spatial reference as WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857 (Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere). A second live query requested in EPSG:3857 confirms the retained Shape__Area and Shape__Length against native projected ring measurements.
sources.source_crs: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84), as recorded in the snapshot spatialReference
sources.native_layer_crs: WKID 102100 / latestWkid 3857, Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere, confirmed by the layer metadata snapshot
sources.geometry_method: Used the sole polygon ring, transformed each longitude/latitude with the project local approximation: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040.0. Simplified the 30-vertex closed ring at 1.2 m RDP tolerance to 25 structural outline vertices before producing the wall shell.
sources.projected_area_reconciliation: The planar shoelace area of the EPSG:3857 query ring is 1,786.0039 m2 and its perimeter is 221.3357551 m, matching Shape__Area=1,785.9961 m2 and Shape__Length=221.3357551 m within rounding. The same ring transformed to the repository local approximation yields 1,033.1 m2 because Web Mercator scale distortion at Purdue is removed by the local lon/lat approximation; these area values are not directly comparable. There is no remaining source area conflict.

sources.method: Visual reference only. It depicts a raised central volume, a large circular window over Greek lettering, lower wings, and a columned entry. It is an illustration rather than a measured elevation; facade orientation, window spacing, story heights, and roof dimensions are not survey verified.

sources.use: Interior finish and furnishing character only
sources.provider: Alpha Gamma Delta Fraternity Housing Corporation gallery
sources.method: Used to inform a schematic furnished lounge and finish palette only. Photos do not provide a measured plan or room-by-room layout.

sources.evidence: Describes a 5,000-square-foot renovation of the existing house and labels the house 2 stories. Renovation area is not the whole building area and was not used as the footprint; the two-story descriptor is contextual and does not verify individual wing or tower heights.

measurements_and_model.placement: Local geometry remains in the campus coordinate approximation derived from the source ring; no manual translation or rotation correction was applied.
measurements_and_model.footprint: Structural walls derive from the GIS ring; exterior entry steps and trim extend slightly beyond it. The ring was not independently matched to CAD or a georeferenced aerial outline.
measurements_and_model.height: Fresh-open mesh bounds are 12.10 m tall, approximately 39.7 ft. This was modeled to the GIS Extrution=40 ft attribute, but the attribute's vertical datum/meaning is not documented. It is not a surveyed roof-height measurement. GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the illustration and Meyer Najem's two-story descriptor.
measurements_and_model.facade: Warm cream stucco, deep charcoal roof, red entry, raised core, round window, Greek lettering, and pilasters are visual interpretations. A small hipped entry canopy was shaped to echo the illustrated portico. Exact facade orientation is not established by the non-georeferenced illustration.
measurements_and_model.interior: Schematic common/lounging, dining, study, and circulation zones. Furniture style is informed by property-specific gallery photos; partitions, room locations, and stairs are not as-built verified. No official plan was available in the retained files.

geometry_edits: Replaced simple massing with a wall shell following the simplified FID 757 ring.
Added two-level wings, parapeted roof, raised central block and gable, windows, floor bands, brick plinth, illustrative Greek lettering, and circular upper-story window.

Added a schematic columned entrance, paired red doors, steps, and a low hipped entry canopy informed by the retained house illustration; partitions, stair, and photo-informed lounge/dining/study furnishings remain schematic.
Merged exact duplicate mesh vertices and removed unused legacy external image datablocks.
mesh_health: The saved mesh is a visually assembled, multi-part surface mesh. Fresh-open check reports 3,026 non-manifold edges, including 980 boundary edges, due to intersecting/open architectural details and schematic furniture. Do not treat the mesh as a watertight fabrication or structural model.

independent_grade.grade_report: Coordinator reports an independent peer grade of 8.1/10 on this exact asset SHA; detailed reviewer report remains coordinator-held.
peer_findings: No plan overlay or independent dimensions/position check; footprint matches the retained GIS ring, but that is not a survey validation.
Facade orientation and window spacing remain illustrative; interior cutaway is sparse and not an as-built plan.
The multi-part mesh has many open/non-manifold edges and is not watertight.
The reviewer notes the Shape__Area versus local transformed ring area difference is explained by Web Mercator scale distortion at latitude 40.4 degrees, not a true geometry conflict.

coordinator_status: Independently graded above 8/10; integrated and fresh-open verified in the master.
